evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3660250 ($4.05, product C, online) scores 0.00 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.04.
Card baseline from 149 earlier transactions: median $58.98, 95th percentile $356.02; the flagged amount is 0.1x the median.

Cardholder C00348 reported the $4.05 charge as not theirs (case pack trigger, 2017-01-28 23:45:16). Measured on October: all 1,203 disputes the bank investigated were fraud, 15% of them scored under 0.05, so a low score does not clear a denial (0.93). If this is a planted dispute on a legitimate transaction, a score this size is 0.07x as likely on disputed fraud as on a legitimate transaction (0.07). Weighted equally: 0.76.
Card-not-present fraud: the number used online without the card; amounts and products that don't fit the cardholder, often two to four within 48 hours.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

case.summary: Card not present fraud on card C00348-K1: 1 transaction(s) from 2017-01-28 to 2017-01-28 totalling $4.05, probability 0.76.
